title: New World's Violet swatch carries from /themes through Use theme

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-09: "allow New World violet in violet-family".

detail: #4677 left New World's Violet swatch out of the builder's accent list because the violet-family probe (LIVE-962) bars the hex outside the files it names. On Daniel's phrase the probe allows that one colour, 8B5CFF, in lib/create-space/preview-site.ts, and the swatch is back in the list.

verify.evidence: node scripts/probes/violet-family.mjs passes; preview-site.test.ts resolves every theme-page swatch, Violet included.
